method: One-pass 7-Zip stdout stream over every221DAT and the single SMA; one file retained in memory, no extracted resource tree written. Every source SHA matches pinned archive inventory, every spawn retains record SHA and original offset.
dat_object_path: CMapProject::LoadMFile reads numeric entry in Map/%04d.dat, copies dwObjectMonsterUniqueNunber from object offset44, and collects EVENT_TYPE_OBJECT_MONSTER6. NPCMapChannel::CreateMonstersBYObject consumes placements subject to runtime gates.
regional_path: CMapProject::LoadMap reads Map/%04d.sma; header20bytes plus tiles76bytes, then int32 count plus60byte MONSTER_CREATE_REGION_INFO records. Only debug builds fall back to .sma2.

raw_condition_summary.note: The native server branches on event_type6 independently of bIsEvent; preserve all records. Runtime eligibility is not assumed from count or visibility.

native_rules.coordinate_units: Native map world units; X/Z origin unchanged, Y altitude; no handedness/center conversion.

object.classification: EVENT_TYPE_OBJECT_MONSTER=6 at AtumParam.h:2297; MonsterUID is OBJECTINFOCLIENT offset44, not next_event_index52.
object.on_delete: Set last timestamp to now and object_created=false (NPCMapChannel.cpp:5138).
object.forced_creation: MustCreate bypasses strategy/teleport automatic-spawn exclusion, interval and channel-count checks, but not every later native gate.
gates: AutoCreateMonsterChannel must be enabled; tutorial/outpost maps skip automatic creation (NPCMapChannel.cpp:238).
An existing live object monster blocks another creation.
Infinity maps initialize object creation blocked and require cinema/regeneration state (MapProject.cpp:773; NPCMapChannel.cpp:675,2778).
Strategy-point/teleport monsters require an explicit server trigger during normal automatic spawning.
Respect channel monster capacity, disabled-spawn state, faction/channel0 checks, and IsEnableCreateMonster war/arena/Jaco conditions.
Current monster definition must exist; constructor drops placements with unknown MonsterUID.
object.raw_fields_note: is_city_war_raw is copied to m_byBossMonster by this server revision; preserve it. event_enabled/body_condition fields are retained, not newly invented spawn gates.

region.normal_first_delay_seconds: respawn_time; per-region last timestamp initializes to channel creation time.
region.population: Count matching monster type in map blocks covering the tile rectangle (NPCGetMonsterCountInRegion:5725); deficit=min(max_monsters-current,respawn_count); spawn RANDI(1,deficit) if positive, bounded by channel/region limits.
region.position: NPCGetCreatablePosition applies native form, size, tile rectangle, altitude, terrain/water and clearance rules; no fixed center is stored in SMA.
region.position_randomization: NPCMapChannel.cpp:5809: x=start_x_tile*40+rand()%((end_x_tile-start_x_tile)*40), and similarly z. The upper bound is EXCLUSIVE. Try at most requested_count*2 candidate positions; reject invalid monster tiles and nearby characters.
region.altitude: For flying forms, native non-absolute altitude is terrain_or_water_height+MinGroundHeight+rand()%(MaxGroundHeight-MinGroundHeight). Ground movers use terrain_or_water_height+monster_size; swimming forms have separate water rules (NPCMapChannel.cpp:5828).
region.on_delete: Decrease current region count and reset region last-creation timestamp.
region.gates: Native auto-create, tutorial/outpost, war/channel, capacity, valid-position and IsEnableCreateMonster gates still apply; caller MustCreate bypasses timing/count prechecks.

covers: MonsterUID44 differs from next_event52 and visual code
all3458 existing record hashes and positions match
all3498 map/monster memberships and source extents
truncated sources and stream boundary refusal

limits: Native data availability is partial: object placements cover only their recorded types; only one map has regional SMA data.
No unsupplied regional SMA records or flying-monster populations are inferred.
Native war/Infinity/cinema/teleport/strategy-point conditions are preserved and require runtime implementation.
Native units and axes are retained; a target runtime must apply its existing map transform exactly once.
